cohort: A woman with a history of pelvic trauma who presented with a labial mass and genitourinary symptoms.
finding: It is important to consider injury to the female bladder and urethra in patients with a history of pelvic trauma and genitourinary symptoms, and successful repair of vesico-vulvar fistulas can be accomplished with cystoscopic fulguration and dissection of the supraurethral fistulous tract.
